items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Yeah, well, Freddie Capard was not the Superia, and Bunk Johnson. There's Bunk Johnson. Who was playing clarinet with them? ... I can remember there was Bunk, Eddie, Eddie Vinson, no no, Eddie Atkins. Eddie Atkins. Bunk, Eddie Atkins.

ctx.x: Now, don't worry about all those exact personnel, there's just a few to identify. A little bit about the Superia.
Yeah, well, Freddie Capard was not the Superia, and Bunk Johnson. There's Bunk Johnson. Who was playing clarinet with them?
There's one picture of the Superia band taken with Keele, not Keele, but Big Eye even in that. Big Eye played.
